create.name: David Crow
create.bio:
David Crow is an American herbalist, acupuncturist, aromatherapist and author who has worked in natural medicine for more than 40 years. He was among the first Westerners to train and be licensed in Chinese medicine, and he studied Ayurvedic and Tibetan medicine through traditional internships in Nepal and India. His book In Search of the Medicine Buddha tells the story of those years in the Himalayas, where he studied with Tibetan physicians and meditation teachers. He founded Floracopeia, which works with small-scale growers and distillers around the world to produce essential oils and botanical products, and he has travelled widely for ethnobotanical research.

David's teaching joins plant knowledge with meditation and ecological spirituality. His courses look at the chakras and the body's inner landscape through Tibetan and yogic traditions, the art of blending essential oils, and heart-centred meditation that uses the rhythm of the heartbeat. He has taught across the United States, Canada and Europe for more than 25 years, and since 2015 has been a regular teacher on The Shift Network, where he also founded and hosted its annual Plant Medicine Summit. He is based in Grass Valley, California, and teaches mainly online.

books.title: In Search of the Medicine Buddha: A Himalayan Journey
books.author: David Crow
books.description: David Crow's account of the ten years he spent in Nepal from 1987, studying Tibetan medicine and Buddhist meditation with a range of teachers. It weaves his own story together with teachings from the Tibetan and Ayurvedic traditions and portraits of the people he met.

books.title: Sacred Smoke: The Magic and Medicine of Palo Santo
books.author: David Crow
books.description: A short book about palo santo, the aromatic tree of South America whose smoke has long been used in ceremony. It follows an Italian psychotherapist and an ethnobotanist into the forests of Ecuador and looks at the tree's cultural history and the threats it faces.

courses.title: The Illuminated Chakras
courses.description: A self-paced course on the chakras as an inner landscape of deity mandalas, subtle channels and cosmology, drawn from Tibetan and yogic traditions. It explains the symbolic meanings of each energy centre and combines meditation with the use of herbs as a support for practice.

courses.title: Aromatic Alchemy: Blending Essential Oils
courses.description: A recorded course on the art, science and spiritual practice of blending essential oils. David explains how aromatic blending links to meditative practice and to the long history of plant-based alchemy.

courses.title: The Matrix of Magic
courses.description: A self-paced Shift Network course on the spiritual side of plant medicine. It presents the body as a meeting of cosmic energies and earthly elements, and teaches ways to work with prana and qi alongside herbs, oils, meditation and yoga practice.

courses.title: An Herbalist’s Journey Through the Body’s 9 Power Centers
courses.description: A self-paced Shift Network course that moves through nine interconnected systems of the body, treated as power centres. Each module pairs plant knowledge with meditative practices from Eastern contemplative traditions.

free_resources.title: The Flowers of Immortality: free mini-course
free_resources.description: A free four-part mini-course on the chakras as flowers that open through meditation and yoga. David covers the history and methods of chakra meditation over the last thousand years and how it applies to spiritual seekers today.

free_resources.title: Heart-Centered Meditation: free mini-course
free_resources.description: A free three-part meditation course based on David's Listening to the Heart method. It teaches a way of meditating with the heartbeat and of sensing the link between the body's rhythms and those of the Earth.

free_resources.title: How to Quiet the Mind: free mandala meditation
free_resources.description: A free guided audio meditation that uses a mandala visualisation to settle a busy mind. It looks at how thoughts carry energy and how to find mental clarity through the breath.

sprint.tier_evidence: YouTube @floracopeia 11.7K subscribers (channel page, 30 Oct 2026); Instagram @floracopeia 27K (og:description, 'Floracopeia - David Crow, L.Ac.'); Facebook /floracopeia 70,023 followers (og:description) → ~108.7k total → luminary
flags: Tier is borderline (~108.7k), and all three accounts belong to his company Floracopeia (branded with his name), not a personal account.
The email (medicinecrow@earthlink.net) appears only in the privacy policy ('contact us at…'); it is published but may not be his main inbox. There is also a contact form.

Strict health-claim rule applied heavily: most of his work is clinical herbalism, and only the spiritually framed items were kept. The Matrix of Magic and 9 Power Centers sales pages still mention health and healing in their body text (headlines are spiritual); a human may want to check them.
Second photo (his own site) shows him in a hat gathering flowers, face partly shaded; consistent with the Shift headshot (beard, build) but not a frontal headshot.
left_out: Shift courses left out for health claims: Botanical Antivirals; Mastering Ayurvedic, Chinese & Western Herbal Formulas to Detox, Rejuvenate & Heal; Tree Medicine (digestive, heart and circulatory claims); Combining Herbs & Essential Oils (treating health conditions); Medicinal Plants for Protecting the Body, Mind and Spirit (prevent disease, inflammation); The Herbalists Community Clinic (clinical diagnosis and treatment internship).

Shift courses left out as borderline (flagged): Illuminated Flower Medicine (headline promises healing properties for physical, mental and emotional health); Medicinal Plants and Spiritual Evolution Intensive (health and longevity framing, 'overcoming illness').

Own-site courses left out for health claims: Protect & Detox from Microplastics; Natural Detoxification; Clinical Level Selfcare for Digestive Problems; Ten Illuminated Herbalism Practices (resistance to illness, throat healing, vision support); Listening to the Heart paid course (page promises healing from grief and past trauma).
Free resources left out: Optimize Your Gut Health; Demystifying Detoxification; Clinical Level Self Care ebook.
Book left out: Plants That Heal: Essays on Botanical Medicine (B00GUSM7MA), title is a healing claim (borderline).

Videos left out: Top 10 Essential Oils for the Home Pharmacy (most viewed, but 'home pharmacy' framing is borderline); Essential Oils For Fighting Contagion; respiratory-health, detox, microplastics and post-Covid videos; Frankincense Tincture (product promotion as a medicine); kitchen-spices oils video (description frames spices as medicine); videos that failed oEmbed (401): Illuminated Chakras excerpts, Listening to the Heart interview, Guidance session 4; Shift Network channel videos (hub).
Consultations ($150 USD) left out: one-to-one clinical consultations are not his main teaching and are medical in nature.
